reason: The inspected applicant journey has convincing local safeguards and coherent, restrained visual craft. Join explains eligibility, materials and evaluation; recruitment outages retain application access instead of asserting unpublished dates. Application save feedback separates device recovery from account persistence. I independently confirmed that submit() now sends unconfirmed 5xx outcomes through bounded reconciliation and explicitly says receipt is unknown and duplicate-safe retry is available; it retains answers. The previously reported ambiguous-result defect is addressed in current source and the five-configuration log. Recovery now offers exact per-field choices, changed-answer emphasis and a clearly labeled private download; the synthetic mobile capture shows readable long responses and reachable combined/whole-copy actions. Stored submission state gates the dashboard receipt, which consistently discloses identifying original-resume access. These are substantial strengths, but they do not establish the unchanged broad world-class proposition. Schedule-fit facts remain absent, approved engagement proof is unavailable, and the actual authenticated preparation-to-status journey has not been demonstrated across the real identity, database and upload boundaries. Local intercepted journeys and source inspection cannot establish successful receipt or recovery for a real applicant. Consequently both broad acceptance and integrated release readiness remain unproven, rather than an inferred approval from scoped tests.

findings.evidence: The weekly-commitment answer explicitly says current weekly hours, mandatory times and peak commitments are not published. Join provides a direct Board email link, but no schedule-fit facts. This remains the factual limitation raised in the prior applicant objections, despite the truthful mitigation.
findings.userImpact: A student cannot independently decide whether membership fits a constrained semester before investing in recruitment and an application.
findings.suggestedFix: Obtain Board-confirmed current-semester workload range, required times and peak-week expectations, then publish them with an update date. Retain the honest contact fallback until those facts are authorized.

notVerified: Real Clerk session/expiry, Supabase RPC/RLS, storage/upload and receipt-email integration; no staging or hosted acceptance is supplied.

A complete sequential keyboard preparation, file-selection, mixed-copy recovery, submission and actual authenticated status journey; tests inspected use direct fill/click/check and synthetic destination responses.
Observed human comprehension/task success, screen-reader use and physical iPhone/macOS Safari behavior.
Live authenticated visual states outside supplied synthetic recovery capture; grading/operator workflows beyond indexed scope were not independently exercised.
Client-approved engagement artifacts and Board policy decisions on resume review, retention and closed-round remediation remain external dependencies.
